# John Tinnerholm

> Personal website of John Tinnerholm, research engineer and postdoctoral researcher at Santa Anna IT Research Institute, Linköping, Sweden. PhD in Computer Science, Linköping University, 2025. Works on compilers, equation-based modeling and simulation (Modelica), Julia, and applied agentic AI. Lead developer of OMJL (OM.jl).

## Pages

- [About](https://jkrt.github.io/): short bio
- [CV](https://jkrt.github.io/cv/): education, experience, appointments, skills
- [Publications](https://jkrt.github.io/publications/): theses, journal and conference papers
- [Teaching](https://jkrt.github.io/teaching/): courses and 19 supervised theses
- [Software](https://jkrt.github.io/software/): open-source projects

## For agents
